sky-pill.purpose: Fill of the primary button, the same sky in both themes; a fill only, never text on a ground.

sky-pill-hover.purpose: Hover of the primary button; lifts 1px.

on-sky.displayName: On Sky (text on the sky pill)
on-sky.purpose: Navy text and key hint on the sky pill, both themes.

warn-line.purpose: Edge of an error notice; its wash in dark is the sheet.

navy-scrim.purpose: Veil behind the palette and the report dialog; navy, never grey.

light-sky-pill-hover.purpose: Hover of the primary button in light.

light-warn-wash.purpose: Pastel fill of an error notice.

graph-0.purpose: Empty day in the practice graph; the ramp is the graph's own green, never next to a diff.

light-graph-0.purpose: Empty day in the practice graph; the ramp is the graph's own green, never next to a diff.

display.purpose: The single page title (h1), including the challenge title.

title.purpose: Sub-headings inside a sheet (h3) and field labels.

body.purpose: Running text; ledes and briefs capped at 68ch.

label.purpose: Margin notes, coach progress, hints, metadata.

galley.purpose: The learner's text in a galley and the answer textarea; open 1.85 leading for marks.

expression.purpose: Phrase on an expression card (20px on the review card).

mono-small.purpose: Chips, kbd keys, nav counts, model id, the room list's "n / 6"; the room timer's number is mono 600 at 20px.

chat.purpose: Message bubbles, peer-correction and coach-check diffs, the chat composer and correction textareas.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Floating layers only (command palette, report dialog, menus). Dark theme: a near-black navy, because a navy lighter than the ground would glow.

shadows.name: float-light
shadows.purpose: Float shadow in the light theme.

shadows.name: inset-ring
shadows.purpose: Selection outline on the checked segment, the selected moderation report and the reported message in a moderation copy; not elevation. The palette row and open conversation take the sky wash instead.

shadows.name: separation-ring
shadows.purpose: Selection outline (not elevation) on the checked mascot in the picker; the same ring, always in ink, marks who is speaking in a voice room.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for press and panel motion.

motion.name: dur-press
motion.purpose: Token for press timing. Buttons themselves transition colour, border and transform over 200ms.

motion.name: button-lift
motion.value: translateY(-1px) on hover (primary, secondary, like); scale(0.98) on press (every button); 200ms on the strong ease-out
motion.purpose: Pill buttons lift and press; a trailing icon after the text would nudge 4px right on hover (dormant: no button has one). Removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: coach-slide
motion.purpose: Coach progress bar segment; stops under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce zeroes durations, stops loops and removes button lift, press and nudge.

motion.name: ease-write
motion.purpose: An even pace for a line being written: the splash pencil and the name reveal (700ms, from 80ms).

motion.name: splash-timing
motion.purpose: Launch splash (lib/splash.ts). Click, Enter, Space or Escape skips it.

motion.name: signin-spinner
motion.purpose: Waiting-for-browser spinner; still under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Home, Feedback and Moderation collapse to one column below this width.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Page side padding 32px, galley margin column 200px, history grid drops track. Profile fact sheet term column 140px. Messages: conversation list 240px, gap 20px, bubbles up to 90%, pane padding 16px sides. Rooms: the idea card and timer move above the people as two equal columns (16px gap).

breakpoints.name: graph-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Practice graph cells drop from 10px to 9px and gaps from 3px to 2px so the year fits without scrolling. The member filters wrap from four columns to two.

breakpoints.name: short-window
breakpoints.purpose: Messages tightens its bottom padding to 20px and its head spacing to 16px. A room tightens its head spacing to 16px and its bar to a 20px top margin with 16px padding.

layout.bannerRatio: 3:1 (6:1 empty band in the sky wash)
layout.profileAvatar: 96px, 5px ground ring, overlapping the banner by 48px
layout.memberFilters: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1.2fr, 16px gap; two columns below 1100px; fields 42px tall
layout.chatThreadMin: 140px; the thread scrolls, the composer area scrolls when the coach check is open
layout.roomsColumn: 760px (head, notices, empty states, create and join sheets, room list)
layout.roomPage: at least 100vh; people column + 320px side column (idea card over timer, 20px apart), 40px gap, capped at 1100px; side column above the people as two equal columns at 1040px and below
layout.roomBar: sticky bottom, ground fill, 1px top rule, 32px above, 16px 0 20px, capped at 1100px; document scroll-padding-bottom 88px while a room is open

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per view: a sky pill with navy text and an optional key hint. Lifts 1px on hover, presses to 0.98, and nothing moves under reduced motion.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">Write it <kbd class="ds-kbd">Enter</kbd></button>

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Borderless pill for tertiary actions such as Copy or Cancel; hover takes the sky wash with ink text, no lift; press scales to 0.98.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-quiet">Copy</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:var(--s2,8px);border-radius:var(--r-pill,999px);padding:9px 18px;font:500 var(--text-base,0.9375rem)/1.6 var(--font-ui,'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif);border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:background-color 200ms ease,color 200ms ease,border-color 200ms ease,transform 200ms var(--ease-out,cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1));padding:9px 12px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-2,#afc0d8)}.ds-btn-quiet:hover{background:var(--pencil-wash,rgb(142 197 255 / 0.14));color:var(--ink,#e6eef9)}.ds-btn-quiet:active{transform:scale(0.98)}.ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#d4e9ff);outline-offset:2px}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-quiet{transform:none!important}}

components.name: Report Dialog
components.description: The second floating layer after the palette: 520px sheet, float shadow, navy scrim backdrop, no open/close animation; reason as radio rows with an ink accent, short sans textarea, quiet Cancel and primary Send.

components.css: .ds-dialog{width:min(520px,92vw);padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;background:var(--sheet,#162033);color:var(--ink,#e6eef9);border:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#33445f);border-radius:var(--r-sheet,10px);box-shadow:0 12px 32px -8px rgb(2 8 20 / 0.55),0 2px 6px rgb(2 8 20 / 0.35);font:400 var(--text-base,0.9375rem)/1.6 var(--font-ui,'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif)}.ds-dialog h2{margin:0;font-size:var(--text-lg,1.0625rem);font-weight:600}.ds-dialog-lede{margin:-8px 0 0;color:var(--ink-2,#afc0d8)}.ds-radio-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:var(--r-control,6px);cursor:pointer}.ds-radio-row:hover{background:var(--sheet-hover,#1c2840)}.ds-radio-row input{accent-color:var(--ink,#e6eef9);width:16px;height:16px;margin:0}

components.name: Splash
components.description: Launch screen on the theme ground: the pencil writes "devTalk" in Public Sans 700, then marks it (rose-struck d, sage D above), holds and fades. 1500ms + 250ms fade; reduced motion shows the still name 300ms. Click, Enter, Space or Escape skips.
components.css: .ds-splash{display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--bg,#0f1726);padding:48px}.ds-splash .w{font:700 100px var(--font-ui,'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif);letter-spacing:-0.01em;fill:var(--ink,#e6eef9)}.ds-splash .d,.ds-splash .s{fill:var(--del,#f0a3b6)}.ds-splash .i{font:700 54px var(--font-ui,'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif);fill:var(--ins,#8fd9ac)}

components.name: GitHub Button
components.description: The primary button with the GitHub mark (Simple Icons, CC0, 16px, currentColor) before "Continue with GitHub". The one primary of a sign-in screen; full column width at 11px vertical padding on Welcome.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn"><svg class="ds-mark" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" fill="currentColor"/></svg>Continue with GitHub</button>
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:var(--s2,8px);border-radius:var(--r-pill,999px);padding:11px 18px;font:500 var(--text-base,0.9375rem)/1.6 var(--font-ui,'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif);border:1px solid transparent;background:var(--accent,#8ec5ff);color:var(--on-accent,#0b2a4f);width:100%}.ds-mark{flex:none}

components.name: Welcome Actions
components.description: First-run sign-in: brand line, 20ch heading, lede, then under a 1px rule the GitHub primary, e-mail secondary and "Practise without an account" quiet (primary when the build has no community). Waiting swaps them for a spinner, "Finish signing in with GitHub in your browser." / "Then come back here." and a secondary Cancel; an error Notice "Sign-in was not finished." sits above. Top padding clamp(56px, 18vh, 176px), not centred.
components.html:
Practise the English you use at work.

A coach marks your writing, and other developers talk with you.
components.css: .ds-wel{max-width:560px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--s2,8px)}.ds-wel h2{max-width:20ch;margin:0;font:700 1.625rem/1.2 var(--font-ui,'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif)}.ds-wel p{margin:0;color:var(--ink-2,#afc0d8)}.ds-acts{margin-top:32px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule,#24324a);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.ds-acts button{width:100%;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:var(--r-pill,999px);font:500 0.9375rem var(--font-ui,'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif);border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-2,#afc0d8)}.ds-acts .ds-p{background:var(--accent,#8ec5ff);color:var(--on-accent,#0b2a4f)}.ds-acts .ds-s{border-color:var(--rule-strong,#33445f);color:var(--ink,#e6eef9)}

narrative.overview:
Every answer the learner writes is a galley, and the coach marks it the way an editor marks a proof: in non-repro blue pencil, with numbered carets in the line and short notes in the margin beside the line they mark. Removals are struck through in dusty rose and insertions sit beside them in sage; these are edits, not grades. The interface around the galley is a quiet desktop tool: a pale sky ground (deep navy in dark), white sheets with 1px rules, sans-serif chrome, and monospace wherever the learner's own words or a reusable expression appear.

Density is that of a working document rather than a dashboard. Content is set in one main column with a narrow side column; lists are ruled, not boxed; headings are sentence-case and plain. The system rejects the category default it was built against: a grey dashboard of stat cards with one violet accent. Progress is shown as facts, ruled lists and tally marks, never as metric tiles.

Dark is the default theme, a night-navy ground with navy sheets and a sky-blue pill; the light theme is a pale sky ground with white sheets, navy ink and a deeper pencil blue for text. Both themes share every structural rule.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, sky blue: a pill fill for the primary action, and pencil blue for the coach's voice as text and marks.
Desaturated rose/sage diff marks on monospace text; never "wrong/right" colouring.
Flat raised sheets defined by 1px rules; shadow only on floating layers. Buttons are pills and the only things that move.
Margin notes aligned row by row to the line they annotate.
Sentence-case, untracked type throughout; no uppercase labels.
A few identifier colours (badge violet and copper, language brand colours, the graph green), each confined to one component.

rules.name: The Blue Pencil Rule
rules.body: Pencil blue is text and marks, and belongs to the coach; the sky pill belongs to the one primary action on a screen. Neither decorates headings, backgrounds or icons that the coach did not "write". The sky wash may only tint a selection or a hover.

rules.name: The Edits, Not Grades Rule
rules.body: Rose and sage appear only as a pair of diff marks inside the learner's text. They are never status colours, never fills, never "correct/incorrect" signals; app errors use amber.

rules.name: The One Home Rule
rules.body: Every colour outside the neutrals has exactly one home: blue for the coach (pencil) and the primary action (sky pill), amber for app problems, rose and sage for the diff, violet for community badges, copper for evolution badges, brand colours for language badges, graph green for the graph. The graph green is never shown next to a diff.

rules.name: The Two Materials Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for the learner's own words, reusable expressions, keys and numbers; everything else is Public Sans. Never set interface chrome in mono or the galley in sans.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Headings and labels are sentence-case with no tracking. The only letter-spacing in the system is the display title's -0.01em.

rules.name: The Float-Only Rule
rules.body: Sheets, cards and buttons cast no shadow; a button's lift is movement, not a shadow. If it is not floating over the page, it has no shadow.

dos: **Do** keep pencil blue to the coach's marks and notes as text, and the sky pill to the one primary action per view.
**Do** use the sky wash for every selected state (current nav row, selected palette row, open conversation) and for the quiet-button hover; keep ink on top of it.
**Do** shape every button as a pill that lifts 1px on hover (primary and secondary) and presses to 0.98, and drop all of that movement under reduced motion.
**Do** put a navy scrim, never black or grey, behind the palette and dialogs, and a near-black navy float shadow in dark.
**Do** set the learner's text, expressions, keys and counts in JetBrains Mono, and everything else in Public Sans.
**Do** align every margin note to the galley line it marks, numbered to match its caret.
**Do** separate rows and sections with 1px rules and a top border rather than wrapping them in cards.
**Do** use the three-step tonal stack (rail, ground, sheet) for depth, and the float shadow only for overlays.
**Do** honour reduced motion: all durations drop to 0ms, looping animations stop, and buttons neither lift, press nor nudge.
**Do** confirm destructive actions inline in a neutral panel, guarded by a typed e-mail or a required reason.
**Do** let the icon carry a member badge's colour and keep its label in ink.
**Do** show an animated banner's first frame, still, under reduced motion or when "Play animated banners" is off.
**Do** make Follow the member profile's one primary action; once followed it becomes a secondary "Following" button.
**Do** mark the current People tab with a 2px ink underline on the rule, and keep Members marked on a member's profile and lists.
**Do** set follower, following and like counts in tabular figures as plain text beside their controls.
**Do** set chat messages, drafts and corrections in the chat mono, as plain text with their line breaks kept.
**Do** show a peer correction or a coach check as a word diff in the galley's rose and sage marks, the marks covering words only.
**Do** keep message actions quiet and under the message, reachable by keyboard and touch, and return focus to the message after an inline panel closes.
**Do** mark who is speaking with the separation ring in ink around their face, and only while they speak.
**Do** keep Mute/Unmute (with `Ctrl M`) and Leave in the room's sticky bottom bar at all times, and keep focused controls and opened panels scrolled above it.
**Do** name the two mutes apart: "Mute for me" silences someone only for you; "Mute for everyone" is a room action in its own ruled group.
**Do** say a room is never recorded where the microphone is asked for, and show the microphone level in secondary ink.
**Do** make the sign-in screen's one primary the GitHub button when the community is configured, and "Practise without an account" when it is not.
**Do** let the splash be skipped by click, Enter, Space or Escape, and show only the still name under reduced motion.
**Do** say where a prefilled value came from ("From your GitHub account") in its hint, until the person changes it.
**Do** count the join steps by the path taken: 3 steps after GitHub, 4 by e-mail.
donts: **Don't** build a dashboard of stat cards or metric tiles; progress is facts, ruled lists and tallies.
**Don't** use rose or sage outside the diff, or label anything "wrong" or "correct".

**Don't** add a second accent colour, tint headings with the pencil, or set pencil blue or the sky pill as the fill of a second button. Use the sky pill only as a fill under `on-sky` text, never as text on a ground. Badge violet and copper, language brand colours and the graph green are identifiers confined to their component, not accents.
**Don't** use violet, copper or the graph green outside member badges and the practice graph, or show the graph beside a diff.
**Don't** add shadows to sheets, cards or buttons; a button lifts, it does not cast.
**Don't** use a neutral grey or pure black veil behind a dialog, or a hard-edged red or saturated amber fill for a notice; warn is a pastel chip.
**Don't** rely on the trailing-icon nudge as a design device until a button actually has a trailing icon; it is dormant.
**Don't** uppercase or letter-space labels, or put small category labels above headings.
**Don't** animate the command palette or the report dialog open or closed.
**Don't** colour destructive actions amber or red; amber stays for problems with the app.
**Don't** colour avatars or stack logos; logos take the text tone. A mascot is the only picture shown when there is no photo, and only language badges carry brand colour.
**Don't** rank or sort people by followers or likes, or give a count its own tile.
**Don't** colour the like heart; liked is the heart filled in the text tone.
**Don't** render chat text as HTML or markdown, or link-ify it; it is always plain text.
**Don't** mark a correction with anything but the diff marks: no rose or sage outside them, no "wrong" or "correct", no score.
**Don't** colour unread: the count is plain mono ink, in the rail and the conversation list, and unread rows are not bolded or tinted.
**Don't** tell a sender their request was declined; a decline is silent.
**Don't** colour the speaking ring, the microphone meter or the muted icon; speaking is ink, never pencil, sage or a status colour.
**Don't** put a sky-pill primary inside a room; speaking is the main act, so the bar and the person options use secondary and quiet buttons only.
**Don't** show recording affordances in a room: no record button, recording dot, saved audio or playback; a voice is never recorded.
**Don't** list one "could not connect" notice per person; name everyone unreachable in one notice.
**Don't** add a tagline, progress bar or button to the splash, or run it longer than 1.5s plus the fade.
**Don't** colour the GitHub mark or give another provider a primary; extra ways in are secondary or quiet.
**Don't** centre the welcome page vertically; its offset keeps the heading still between waiting, error and the buttons.
